taxonomy_candidate_decisions.name: Infrastructure–Governance Authority Separation
taxonomy_candidate_decisions.recognition: Reliance and significant consequential restriction evidenced; published documents do not resolve independent authorisation or prove dependency served as authority.
taxonomy_candidate_decisions.missing: Applicable service contract, controlling delegated instrument, authorised change decision and independent service/security rationale.

taxonomy_candidate_decisions.name: Infrastructural Access Choice Integrity
taxonomy_candidate_decisions.recognition: A service limit and contemporaneous U.S. pressure are separately reported.
taxonomy_candidate_decisions.missing: Authenticated linkage or concession demand conditioning satellite access on Ukraine changing refinery strikes or another policy decision.

taxonomy_candidate_decisions.name: Capability-Authority Separation
taxonomy_candidate_decisions.recognition: Ability to restrict access is apparent.
taxonomy_candidate_decisions.missing: Proof the deciding actor treated capability itself as sufficient permission, not contractual or government-delegated authority.

taxonomy_candidate_decisions.name: Objective–Pathway Authority Separation
taxonomy_candidate_decisions.recognition: Reported government policy goals and service restriction appear in temporal proximity.
taxonomy_candidate_decisions.missing: Evidence an identified objective was actually used to authorise a pathway outside a valid authority scope.

taxonomy_candidate_decisions.name: Jurisdiction-Bounded Infrastructure Authority
taxonomy_candidate_decisions.missing: Evidence that a bounded sovereign rule was propagated outside its valid jurisdiction or function rather than under independently authorised cross-border service powers.

taxonomy_candidate_decisions.name: Governance Neutrality
taxonomy_candidate_decisions.recognition: Commercial and government actors had potentially differing interests.
taxonomy_candidate_decisions.missing: An actual neutral review function was required/represented and was captured or materially biased as the required recognition conditions describe.

taxonomy_candidate_decisions.name: Required Governance Routing
taxonomy_candidate_decisions.missing: Named mandatory route, contrary bypass event and resulting missing governance effect; secrecy or disagreement alone does not establish bypass.

taxonomy_candidate_decisions.name: Control Effectiveness Integrity
taxonomy_candidate_decisions.missing: Identity and valid activation of a specific applicable protective control that was materially ineffective; harm alone is not control ineffectiveness.

taxonomy_candidate_decisions.name: Actor–Action Attribution
taxonomy_candidate_decisions.missing: Evidence that an applicable action attribution system itself lost or falsified actor/action evidence; absent public information is not by itself an observability control failure.
